findings: Original CLI, real synthetic JPEG files: source sorts first, top=1 consumes source slot before exclusion and returns zero; unlimited search finds the exact duplicate. Existing CLI top test only checks successful return.

Missing search directory and corrupt JPEG candidate both return exit 0 and zero matches. Original FindImages test explicitly expects missing directory to succeed with empty results; this policy does not communicate incomplete scans to callers.
PNG-only search directory returns zero despite PNG decoder registration: JPEG-only discovery policy, not decoder failure.
EXIF orientation mapping test checks only local map length, not Extract. Metadata dimensions mismatch is logged rather than asserted.
CLI output sorts matches after early TopN truncation; sorting cannot recover omitted candidates. File writes and deferred close errors are unchecked by source inspection, not fault injection.
